prime-gaps.reason: Prime gaps, sieve bounds and short-interval arithmetic estimates.

exponential.reason: The analytic selection uses this curated tag for exponential-sum and exponent-pair methods.

exponential-sums.reason: Exponential-sum estimates and their analytic applications.

mean-values.reason: Mean-value estimates and transforms in classical analysis.

subconvexity.reason: Analytic subconvex and related central-value estimates.

zero-counting.reason: Zero localization and counting, including zeta and supporting polynomial counting techniques.

density.reason: Zero-density estimates for the analytic selection.

multiplicative orthogonality.reason: Correlations, orthogonality estimates and mean-value methods for arithmetic functions.

Beurling systems and Mellin tools.reason: Generalized primes, Mellin inversion and Tauberian or oscillation tools. This is a methods tag without a transfer assertion to the classical zeta function.

restriction and mean values.reason: Restriction and mean-value bounds used as portable analytic methods.

Entire functions and real-rooted approxi.reason: Entire function and real-rooted approximation tools. The tag does not assert a result on zeta zeros.

Laguerre–Pólya and entire-function appro.reason: Portable entire function and Laguerre–Pólya theory.

Pólya frequency and stability.reason: Portable total positivity and stability-preserver theorems.

Pólya frequency, multiplier sequences an.reason: Portable total positivity, multiplier and stability-preserver methods.

Jensen and Turán inequalities.reason: Portable polynomial inequalities, including partition applications.

de Bruijn–Newman heat flow.reason: Deformation of zeros by the de Bruijn–Newman heat flow.

application of finite verification.reason: An application of certified finite-range input.

Lefschetz trace and arithmetic geometry.reason: Arithmetic or geometric trace and fixed-point formulas.

point counts and exponential sums.reason: Point count or character sum work in a finite-field or geometric setting.

weights, monodromy and companions.reason: Cohomological weights, monodromy or companion questions.

standard conjectures and intersection po.reason: Intersection positivity and standard conjectures in algebraic geometry.

motivic positivity.reason: Motivic or geometric antecedents, including categorical tools.

number-field spectral transfer.reason: Arithmetic realization and comparison projects. Operator and dynamics labels require the more specific scope.

Artin and Galois realization.reason: Artin functions or Galois-representation and realization questions.

zeta special values.reason: Geometric-bibliography special values, cohomological formulations or regularized determinants.

spectral flow.reason: The geometry selection uses this tag for spectral or Lefschetz constructions and geometric zeta functions.
